group.purpose: Heading of the group of conflicts in the Review queue.
group.where: Review screen, queue, above the list of fields that have conflicts.

fieldCount_one.purpose: How many conflicts one field has (one).
fieldCount_one.where: Review screen, queue, beside a field's name in the Conflicts group.

fieldCount_other.purpose: How many conflicts one field has (several).
fieldCount_other.where: Review screen, queue, beside a field's name in the Conflicts group.

field.Name.purpose: Names the track title field of a conflict.
field.Name.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Artist.purpose: Names the artist field of a conflict.
field.Artist.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Composer.purpose: Names the composer field of a conflict.
field.Composer.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Album.purpose: Names the album field of a conflict.
field.Album.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Genre.purpose: Names the genre field of a conflict.
field.Genre.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Comments.purpose: Names the comment field of a conflict (rekordbox's Comments, My Tags included).
field.Comments.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Remixer.purpose: Names the remixer field of a conflict.
field.Remixer.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Label.purpose: Names the record label field of a conflict.
field.Label.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Year.purpose: Names the year field of a conflict.
field.Year.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.DiscNumber.purpose: Names the disc number field of a conflict.
field.DiscNumber.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.TrackNumber.purpose: Names the track number field of a conflict.
field.TrackNumber.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.PlayCount.purpose: Names the play count field of a conflict.
field.PlayCount.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Rating.purpose: Names the rating field of a conflict.
field.Rating.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Colour.purpose: Names the color field of a conflict.
field.Colour.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.DateAdded.purpose: Names the date added field of a conflict.
field.DateAdded.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

field.Location.purpose: Names the file location field of a conflict.
field.Location.where: Review screen, Conflicts group and the pane of that field.

label.purpose: Accessible name of the table of one field's conflicts.
label.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, the table (read by screen readers).

col.track.purpose: Column heading: the track the conflict is about.
col.track.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, table heading.

col.app.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, table heading.

col.rekordbox.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, table heading.

col.base.purpose: Column heading: the value at the last send to rekordbox.
col.base.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, table heading.

col.actions.purpose: Column heading for the buttons of each conflict (not drawn, read by screen readers).
col.actions.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, table heading.

neverSent.purpose: Says the field was never sent, so there is no earlier value.
neverSent.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, Last sent column.

noValue.purpose: Says a side holds no value for the field.
noValue.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, any value column.

noRating.purpose: Says a track has no rating (zero stars).
noRating.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, a Rating value.

stars_one.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, a Rating value and the rating choice.

stars_other.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, a Rating value and the rating choice.

action.keepApp.purpose: Settles one conflict with the app's value.
action.keepApp.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, button at the end of a conflict's row.

action.keepRekordbox.purpose: Settles one conflict with rekordbox's value.
action.keepRekordbox.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, button at the end of a conflict's row.

action.edit.purpose: Opens a field to give the value by hand.
action.edit.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, button at the end of a conflict's row.

action.save.purpose: Settles the conflict with the value given by hand.
action.save.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, row being edited. Greyed out while the value doesn't fit the field.

action.goBack.purpose: Leaves editing without settling the conflict.
action.goBack.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, row being edited.

action.keepAppAll.purpose: Settles every conflict of the field with the app's value.
action.keepAppAll.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, under the table ({{count}} is how many conflicts the field has).

action.keepRekordboxAll.purpose: Settles every conflict of the field with rekordbox's value.
action.keepRekordboxAll.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, under the table ({{count}} is how many conflicts the field has).

edit.label.purpose: Names the field where a value is given by hand.
edit.label.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, row being edited (read by screen readers).

edit.noColor.purpose: Chooses to give the field no color.
edit.noColor.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, row being edited, Color field.

error.gone.purpose: Says the conflict was resolved already, so nothing was changed.
error.gone.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, shown when a resolve is refused.

error.badValue.purpose: Says the value given by hand doesn't fit the field, so nothing was changed, and what to do.
error.badValue.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, shown when a resolve is refused.

error.changed.purpose: Says the number of conflicts changed since the screen showed it, so a bulk resolve settled nothing.
error.changed.where: Review screen, Conflicts pane, shown when "Keep ... for all" is refused because conflicts were added or settled meanwhile.
